title: Family (a)/(h): PNT two-sided window must be verified along the whole orbit tail

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Minor but genuine gap in the application of the (P) bound to families (a) primes and (h).**

The specialisations invoke 'bounds (P) hold for all large $x$' and then apply Lemma rates(P). Beyond the structural problem in case (P) (separate issue), one must explicitly verify that the two-sided window $\tfrac12\le \pi(x)/(x/\log x)\le 2$ holds throughout the part of the orbit where the leading-order count is accumulated, AND separately bound the bounded tail through small $x$ where $\pi(x)/(x/\log x)$ leaves $[\tfrac12,2]$ (it does for small $x$). Without this the asymptotic constant is not controlled. (For (h) this is moot because (h)'s premise is itself wrong — see the Smarandache issue.)
